The river that runs through London is the River Thames.

The cohesion of the provided text is strong. It employs effective transitional and linking devices to maintain logical flow. The phrase "also to blame" in the second sentence connects the new cause (water temperature) to the previous one (ocean acidification). The demonstrative pronoun "These" in the third sentence clearly refers back to "Coral reefs" from the first sentence. Finally, the phrase "This situation" in the fourth sentence acts as a cohesive tie, summarizing the preceding issues (acidification, warming, and declining fish populations) to introduce the broader impact on human communities.
